remarks: The ease of one-level living meets the style and updates today's renters are looking for in this beautifully renovated sprawling ranch in Stamford's sought-after Mid-Ridges neighborhood. Freshly painted inside and out with a newly renovated kitchen and beautifully updated bathrooms, the home is filled with natural light and features hardwood floors, bright, inviting living spaces, and an easy flow for everyday living. Enjoy a fully fenced backyard with a patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, plus a two-car garage and abundant storage. Conveniently located just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro North, the Merritt Parkway, I-95, shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, and houses of worship, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and move-in-ready living.
